source.label: thm:expected-regret-bound
source.quote: If \cref{alg:proper-ts} satisfies \Prob*{\sup_{\Arm\in\ArmSet_t}\Inner{\Arm,\TsSample_t}\geq\sup_{\Arm\in\ArmSet_t}\Inner{\Arm,\Param}\Given\Param,\HistoryPlus_t}\geq\OptProb, whenever $\Norm{\Estimator_t-\Param}_{\SymCovMatrix_t^{-1}}\leq\Radius$, we then have \Regret(T,\PolicyTS)\leq\OrderLog*{\frac{\Radius\Inflation}{\OptProb}\sqrt{\Dim T}}.

results.notes: Regret defined as Bayesian regret; frequentist follows with point-mass prior. Conditional result on an optimism assumption.

applied.reason: The non-zero arm in Example 1 has 2d coordinates equal to ±1/sqrt(d), so its Euclidean norm is sqrt(2), not at most 1.

_verify.summary: The extraction is accurate. All seven results (Theorem 3.1, Theorem 9.1, Corollaries 9.1 and 9.2, Propositions 3.1 and 3.2, and Corollary 3.2) have the right expressions, constants, probabilities and settings. The only error is the norm bound for the Example 1 action set: the arm has norm sqrt(2), so it should be bounded_L rather than unit_l2.
